text.tspan: Principles on How to Be a Proper Human Being — General
Let’s pick it up, let’s pick it up,
If we see it on the ground, let’s pick it up.
Let’s pick it up, let’s pick it up,
If we see it on the ground, let’s pick it up!
Take out the trash, take out the trash,
If we see that it is full, take out the trash.
Take out the trash, take out the trash,
If we see that it is full, take out the trash!
Get the homework done, get the homework done,
Get it finished, get it over, get it done.
Get the homework done, get the homework done,
Get it finished, get it over, get it done!
